limitations: Seven BLOCKED_SCOPED observations are harness observations, not full guarantee passes.
The launcher uses a mutable extensionDevelopmentPath. Matching bundle hashes do not establish an immutable snapshot of every runtime dependency.

The legacy evidence schema has no unique run ID, timestamps, exact OS build, full policy/grant state or broker bundle identity. This record supplements correlation from user stdout and post-run inspection; it does not retroactively measure those missing fields.

The shared historical live-host.json was overwritten by the user-run launcher. Its Phase1 historical digest was b84cd27912535e4081ee8a0dcd419cd301b0d276b1d6b34b25f97287235b286e. Recovery of those prior raw bytes has not been established in this step.
The Git history observation is present; the editor Git discovery warning does not establish that fixture Git was skipped or that F16 is fixed.
Git history was observed after the repository deny had been removed; it does not verify history under a continuously active mark.
The environment/output observation concerns a deliberately injected synthetic child, not the broker child.
Encoded synthetic data reached a loopback receiver; this is not verification of an OS-wide Internet egress boundary.
No real assistant, remote provider, native-baseline syntax repair, lifecycle proof, clipboard/display isolation or selected-architecture assertion was evaluated by this bookkeeping step.
rollback: Documentation-only: retain this archived evidence and withdraw erroneous claims through a new correction record. No enforcement, credentials, ACLs or protected assets changed.
